Confidence.description:
A probability in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0].

Confidence is reported, never inferred by a model at runtime: it comes from
how specifically a probe's response matched an interpretation rule.

EndpointFilter.description:
Narrow a folded scan to the endpoints worth looking at.

Every field is optional, and an endpoint is kept only if it satisfies all
the fields that were supplied.

min_confidence.description:
Keep only endpoints identified with at least this confidence. An
endpoint carrying no identification at all is dropped by this field.

port_range.description: Keep only endpoints whose port falls inside this inclusive range.

service.description: Keep only endpoints whose identified service matches this exactly.

state.description:
Keep only endpoints in this reachability state. An endpoint whose
state was never observed is dropped by this field.

PortState.description:
The observed reachability of one endpoint.

`Filtered` and `Closed` are distinct on purpose: a closed port is positive
evidence that a host is up, a filtered port is evidence of a middlebox.

oneOf.description: Probed, but the response was contradictory across retries.

description:
Fold a scan's event log into per-endpoint state and return the endpoints
that match a filter.
